measurement_scope: One actual 2025-11-30 invocation, isolated from candidate fitting. Wall time includes interpreter startup, imports, all input preparation, forecast fitting/inference, ordering and CSV output. Process RSS is absolute OS high-water memory, includes imports, prepared frames, arrays and output. It upper-bounds fit and inference, not their separate incremental peaks. Not full AI-assisted analysis/build elapsed time; not a guarantee on other hardware.

cpu_and_memory_assessment.ordinary_8GB_suitability: Measured process peak far below 1 GB at supplied 5 MB / 17k-row sales scale. Leaves multiple GB for OS and apps within an 8 GB computer. Host RAM is not assumed to be 8 GB; projection conditional on comparable Python environment and data scale. Memory grows with calendar length times active products at stores plus input rows; future much larger files require remeasurement.

routine_running_usage.AI_assisted_build_cost: Not measured; distinct from this routine invocation
